title: Biosimilar Versus Innovator Ranibizumab in Myopic CNVM: Comparative Real-World Outcomes- The BRIM Study

license.statement: Dove Medical Press licence incorporating CC BY-NC 4.0 (unported) (article <license>); non-commercial, so private

condition: Treatment-naive myopic choroidal neovascular membrane (axial length above 26.5 mm or spherical equivalent of -6.00 D or more), retrospective comparative multicentre real-world study in India (January 2021 to December 2023), at least 12 months of follow-up after the start of anti-VEGF therapy

groups.agent: ranibizumab 0.5 mg/0.05 mL (Lucentis/Accentrix), PRN after the first injection
groups.description: Group A; agent chosen in routine care (assignment known at baseline)

groups.agent: biosimilar ranibizumab (Razumab) at the equivalent dose, PRN after the first injection
groups.description: Group B; agent chosen in routine care (assignment known at baseline)

series.notes: Central macular thickness (CMT) on Cirrus 5000 SD-OCT, no subfield definition; mean ± SD (Methods); per-visit n not reported (inclusion required at least 12 months of follow-up)
Central macular thickness (CMT) on Cirrus 5000 SD-OCT, no subfield definition; mean ± SD (Methods); per-visit n not reported (inclusion required at least 12 months of follow-up)

notes: Two marketed ranibizumab products compared without an investigational agent: both groups are control groups
Group sizes (eyes) from the Abstract and the Table 1 sex counts
Regimen: PRN from the first injection guided by OCT and clinical activity (no fixed loading phase stated)
